purpose: VibeVoice-ASR Q4_K_M batched prefill: write a Q6_K ffn_down result straight into the bf16 residual instead of widening it to f32 and narrowing it straight back
hardware: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395, Radeon 8060S (gfx1151), 256-bit LPDDR5X, 133 GB unified

protocol.weights: Q4_K_M backbone via /tmp/vibevoice-asr-q4km.gguf; the llama-quantize Q4_K_M ruleset upgrades attn_v and ffn_down to Q6_K on 14 of the 28 layers
protocol.change: q4_prefill's gemm_bf16_f32 helper gained an optional bf16_out target. ffn_down feeds the bf16 residual with no intervening op, so a Q6_K down projection now writes the WMMA kernel's bf16 output directly into the residual buffer, dropping the bf16->f32 widening and the f32->bf16 narrowing that immediately followed it. Q4_K down projections still narrow from f32, since that route has only an f32 output.
protocol.exactness: bf16->f32 widening is exact and narrowing an exactly-representable value back to bf16 is the identity, so the skipped pair changes no value. Verified over the full 16-bit bf16 pattern space (1048576 patterns including subnormals, +/-0, +/-inf and NaN): 0 mismatches.
protocol.workload: 89-row prompt, one batched q4 prefill per trial, 3 warmup runs then 5 timed trials
protocol.command: python3 scripts/vibevoice_q4_prefill_launches.py --route q4 --repeat --json <artifact> (loads /tmp/vibevoice-asr-q4km.gguf, prompt from tests/fixtures/vibevoice_asr/vibevoice_asr_lm.npz), run against HEAD and against the change. It reports the conversion launches as bf16_to_f32 + f32_to_bf16: 196 on HEAD (28 + 168) and 168 with the change (14 + 154).

results.launches_removed_breakdown: 14 Q6_K ffn_down layers x 2 (one bf16_to_f32 widening, one f32_to_bf16 narrowing)
results.remaining_bf16_to_f32: 14, one per Q6_K attn_v, which does need f32 for its bias add
results.prefill_wall_time_change: none measurable: 221.3 vs 222.3 ms median, inside a 5-8% run-to-run spread. The 28 removed launches move roughly 53 MB less data (about 0.35 ms at these shapes) and are about 0.3% of prefill, so no wall-time claim is made.

reproduction_with_committed_harness.note: the committed harness reproduces the after-change conversion counts exactly (14 + 154 = 168) and reports a stable output hash. Its hash witness covers the prompt buffer after prefill_rows has written the post-layer-stack rows, which is a different buffer from the one the original probe hashed, so the two hash values are not comparable. The before-change counts come from the parent revision measured with the original probe; on the current revision, restoring the round trip would add one bf16_to_f32 and one f32_to_bf16 per Q6_K ffn_down (14 each), giving 196.

gates.new_launch_count_gate: test_q6_k_down_proj_skips_the_round_trip is RED on HEAD (28 bf16_to_f32 launches, expected 14) and GREEN with the change
gates.new_exactness_gate: test_q6_k_down_proj_direct_bf16_matches_the_round_trip compares the direct route against the widen/narrow round trip on a real Q6_K ffn_down weight and requires bit-identical bf16 bytes

profile.why: the change is byte-exact on the affected surface (identical output hash before and after), so it meets the strict arithmetic contract, which is stronger than production requires.
profile.not_claimed: this artifact is not a full production qualification. Production promotion additionally requires the calibrated mean/p95/p99/max KL envelope, top-1 by category/shape, same-schedule determinism, isolation, BF16-relative and task-quality gates per docs/EXECUTION-PROFILES.md section 6, which were not run here.

notes: Retained as a launch-count and memory-traffic reduction with bit-identical output, not as a speed win. AGENTS.md allows launch-count and verified sub-window reductions to be retained when same-session variance hides the headline ratio; this artifact states plainly that prefill wall time is unchanged.

The Q6_K o_proj branch in gemm_f32_f32 has the same shape of redundancy (bf16 -> f32 -> bf16), but o_proj is Q4_K on every layer of this model, so that branch is not exercised and was deliberately left alone rather than changed untested.
